videos.why: The topic with the most proven demand (a 2.5M-view breakout). It has the fullest picture of the four: animals in the stables, a stone door rolling shut, a well with a bucket, and a crowd under the carved 20,000. Moved above rank's 6.6.
strengths: Breakout topic: 2.5M views on a 77K channel
People or animals moving in every layer
Payoff figure carved in the room, not on a card
risks: Title opens 'The City Under…' while the recipe prefers 'What's Under…'

videos.why: A crossing everyone knows, trains in every layer, and an undersea length you can feel. Its first frame (sea and cliffs) is less instantly recognisable than Derinkuyu's town.
A surprising engineering secret (a pillared flood tank under a field), with the figures on tablets in place. Less known by name than the other two, so the first second does less work.
strengths: Strange reveal: a flood channel under a playing field
risks: 25 s, at the top of the band

videos.why: World-famous subject, but a foundation has no movement and the payoff (110,000 tonnes) is abstract. The kit's new pieces make the three new Shorts fuller.
